items.headline: Warsh speech pushes next-Fed-meeting rate-hike expectations above 50%
items.summary: Reuters reports Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated that inflation must return to 2% and signaled further action may be needed if progress stalls. Short-term Treasury yields and the dollar rose, while market pricing for a rate hike at the next FOMC meeting moved above 50% from about 35% before the speech.
items.whyItMatters: A material repricing toward tighter Fed policy raises yields and the dollar and can pressure crypto risk appetite across the monitored universe.
items.actionReason: The event is over and the verified policy repricing is hawkish, but this overlay cannot create an exit or trade instruction. The latest Crypto Reca Radar is still stale at 2026-08-26 20:01 Madrid, so there is no fresh independent technical confirmation or conflict assessment.

items.headline: Solana disinflation proposal SGP-0002 narrowly leads while fee-burn proposal remains below threshold
items.summary: CoinDesk reports all three Solana governance proposals have cleared quorum. SGP-0002 has 68.77% support versus the two-thirds threshold, while SGP-0003 has 62.72%; voting remains open.
items.whyItMatters: If the faster-disinflation mandate passes, future SOL issuance would decline more quickly, reducing dilution; however the vote is not final and implementation would still require separate technical work.
items.actionReason: Fundamental context only; it cannot create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Final U.S. spot bitcoin ETF data show $242.3M net inflows on Aug. 27, extending the positive streak to nine sessions
items.summary: Farside's current table shows $242.3M net inflows for U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs on Aug. 27; Aug. 17 through Aug. 27 are nine consecutive positive trading sessions.
items.whyItMatters: Sustained regulated-product inflows strengthen near-term institutional-demand context.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF demand is contextual support only and cannot create a Crypto Reca entry.

items.headline: Bitcoin treasury-company model unwinds as top holders turn net sellers
items.summary: Financial Times analysis found the 50 largest bitcoin-treasury companies shifted to net selling in July, selling about 2,500 more BTC than they bought; Strategy sold nearly 7,000 BTC between late June and mid-August to fund interest-bearing obligations.
items.whyItMatters: Corporate treasury buyers had been an incremental source of BTC demand; a shift toward net selling can remove demand and create supply overhang.
items.actionReason: Structural institutional-flow warning only, not an exit instruction.

items.headline: Charles Schwab plans to add Solana and Avalanche trading in coming months
items.summary: CoinDesk reports Charles Schwab plans to add SOL and AVAX trading to Schwab Crypto in the coming months.
items.whyItMatters: Broader brokerage access can incrementally improve institutional and retail accessibility for SOL and AVAX.
items.actionReason: Institutional-access context only; positive news never creates a buy signal.

items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs extend inflow streak and cumulative demand
items.summary: U.S. spot SOL ETFs added $33.5M on Aug. 24, $32.2M on Aug. 25 and $3.6M on Aug. 26; Aug. 27 currently shows 0.0.
items.whyItMatters: Persistent regulated-product inflows strengthen institutional-demand context for SOL.
items.actionReason: No fresh executable trigger is independently confirmed by Crypto Reca.

catalysts.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Jackson Hole keynote
catalysts.summary: The event is resolved. Reuters reports the speech pushed next-meeting Fed rate-hike pricing above 50% from roughly 35% beforehand, with short-term Treasury yields and the dollar rising.
catalysts.whyItMatters: The event materially repriced rate expectations, yields and the dollar, creating a tighter macro backdrop for crypto risk assets.
catalysts.actionReason: The pre-event avoidance window has ended. Monitor post-event price structure; do not infer a trade from the macro outcome alone.
